features: DATABASE CHANGE — One migration, re-runnable without harm, adds to the breakdown rows the column anagrafica_immobile_id: the link between every share of an instalment plan and the title row it comes from. On rows already written it stays empty: it is written by plans generated or recalculated from this version on, and for the others the settlement deduces it on the fly, only where there is a single possible row. If the title row disappears (a person is dissociated, a transfer is cancelled), the share stays as it is and loses only the link. The topic is twofold. After several transfers on the same unit the settlement recognised every share by the role of whoever received it, not by where it came from, and it stopped or got it wrong; now every share carries its title row and the settlement follows it along the chain. And at the end of a usufruct, with another one running, not all the bare owners become full owners again any more: only whoever has to does.

CHANGED: AT THE END OF A USUFRUCT, WITH ANOTHER ONE RUNNING ON THE UNIT, ONLY THE BARE OWNER OF THAT USUFRUCT BECOMES FULL OWNER AGAIN — Example, on an item of € 1,200.00 a year charged to the usufructuary: Ugo has the usufruct of one half (bare ownership to Mara) and Elsa that of the other half (bare ownership to Carlo); Ugo's usufruct ends on 1 April. Up to .42 Carlo's bare ownership, which is still under Elsa's usufruct, also became full again, and the settlement was split between Mara and Carlo (€ 226.03 and € 226.02); now only Mara's becomes full again, and the 275 days from 1 April are all Mara's: € 452.05 as a debit to Mara and a credit to Ugo. The panel reminds that this is the rule of law, and that with the accrual to the other usufructuary the termination is not recorded from here.

CHANGED: THE PROGRAM SAYS WHICH BARE OWNERSHIP BECOMES FULL AGAIN, IN THIS ORDER, AS LONG AS THE DATA SAY SO — First the transfer from which the usufruct was born, if the program recorded it (a creation, a sale with reserved usufruct): it points to the bare ownership, even if it was sold later or added up to another one, and the form asks nothing; if the bare ownership was added up to another one, only the part that the transfer knows becomes full again, and if it knows less, the administrator chooses. Then the sum of the shares: if the possible bare owners together are worth exactly the usufruct that ends, all of them become full owners again. Finally the rule of law: a single bare owner worth more than the usufruct that ends (two parents donate with reserved usufruct to a single bare owner, and one of the parents dies) becomes full owner for the 50 % that ends and stays bare owner of the other 50 %; up to .42 the bare owner became full owner for 100 %. Where not even this is enough (holders entered by hand) the administrator decides.

CHANGED: WHERE THE DATA DO NOT SAY WHICH BARE OWNERSHIP, THE ADMINISTRATOR CHOOSES — In the «Who goes back to full ownership» card every bare owner of the unit has a checkbox, and none is ticked to begin with: tick the bare owners of the part on which the usufruct ends, which together are worth as much as the usufruct. There is also the checkbox «All the bare owners, each for their share», to be used if the bare ownership is held in common among the bare owners: each bare owner becomes full owner for their part of the usufruct that ends and stays bare owner of the rest (two bare owners at 50 % under two usufructs of 50 %: each for 25 %). If no combination of whole bare ownerships is worth the usufruct, the checkboxes are not there and only «each for their share» remains. Without a choice the termination is refused and asks for one; with a choice worth 100 % on a usufruct of 50 % it is refused and says so; a row of another unit does not count as a choice, even with the right share. With several bare owners the settlement pair is one per bare owner, according to the part that goes back to each, when known, or by share.

CHANGED: A PERSON LEAVING WHO IS ALSO A BARE OWNER DOES NOT BECOME FULL OWNER AGAIN UNDER ANOTHER USUFRUCT, AND THERE IS NO LONGER A PAIR WITH THE SAME PERSON — With another usufruct running, if the person leaving is also bare owner of the other part, that part does not become full again with the usufruct that ends: the bare ownership of the other bare owner becomes full again by itself, with no choice, and the settlement is all that bare owner's, as in the first point. Without another usufruct running all the bare owners become full owners again, the person leaving included: their part, also on an appurtenance, stays in their name outside the settlement, and the panel says so. Up to .42, if the person leaving was also a bare owner, the settlement wrote a pair as debit and credit of the same person (if they were the only bare owner) or stopped (if there was more than one bare owner); now, with Ugo usufructuary of the whole unit and bare owner of one half, and the bare ownership of the other half held by Mara, the € 904.11 that the settlement moves from the usufructuary are divided by share: € 452.06 stay with Ugo, € 452.05 go to Mara, and the pair is a single one, with Mara. In the history, the transfer names as the incoming person the bare owner other than the person leaving.

CHANGED: WHEN THE DATA ARE NOT ENOUGH, THE TERMINATION IS REFUSED AND RECORDED BY HAND — With another usufruct running the program does not guess in three forms: the transfer from which the usufruct was born leads to a bare ownership of the person leaving; the person leaving has a bare ownership bought while being usufructuary, which may be that of the part that ends; the bare owners that can become full owners again are worth less than the usufruct that ends. The termination is refused, with the route by hand: close the usufruct row on the day before, from «Edit association», and correct the rows of the bare owners according to the deed, with no automatic settlement. Same route if the bare ownership was born on the very day of the termination and would become full again only in part. For the second of two terminations on the same day on the same rows the refusal is the same, but the message does not indicate a route: the rows are corrected by hand, or support is asked for. With the appurtenances ticked, the transfer is refused where the rule does not decide there: if a choice is needed, it says to record the termination from the appurtenance, where the choice is made; if the program stops, it says to remove the tick and record the appurtenance by hand from «Edit association». A refusal writes nothing.

CHANGED: THE TERMINATION FORM LOOKS AT THE DAY OF THE DEED, NOT AT TODAY — The card looks at the rows running on the day written for the termination: from 1 April, with Carlo's bare ownership sold on 1 June, the termination goes through if Mara's bare ownership is chosen and is refused if the one that was sold is chosen. When the person leaving, the choice between creation and termination, or the date changes, choices and errors are reset; without a date it uses today's date for whoever records, not the UTC day, which between midnight and one or two in the morning in Rome, depending on daylight saving time, is still the day before. Where the termination is refused there is an amber line with the reason, and no checkboxes. The caption says that the bare owner of the usufruct that ends becomes full owner again.

CHANGED: «WHO REMAINS LIABLE» SAYS FOR WHICH PART WHOEVER BECOMES FULL OWNER AGAIN ANSWERS — With another usufruct running, with a bare ownership that becomes full again only in part, or on a mixed unit (a full owner of the other half), the sentence said that the bare owner becomes full owner again and answers for all the expenses of the unit: false, because the other part stays with its holders. Now it says «Carlo (for 25 %) and Dora (for 25 %) become full owners again of the part of the usufruct that ends and answer for it, each for their part; for the rest of the unit the holders of that part answer, as before (the bare owner and the usufructuary jointly, art. 67 last paragraph of the implementing provisions of the Civil Code)», also in the history, which for transfers recorded from this version says who becomes full owner again and for which part. Where no other holder remains on the unit the sentence is the usual one.

CHANGED: THE SETTLEMENT OF TRANSFERS IN A CHAIN NO LONGER STOPS WHERE THE PART THAT PASSES IS CERTAIN — In .41 and .42, in these forms, the settlement of the transfers after the first stopped and the part that passes was written by hand with a manual balance from the Wallet. Now every share is followed from the title row it comes from, and the settlement calculates, even with several bare owners and reservations. Two cases on an item of € 1,200.00 a year, with what each person really pays; «with the law» and «as each item says» are the two choices, made at the reservation or at the creation, on who pays the ordinary expenses. First case: a sale, a repurchase, a new sale. Ugo sells to Bice on 1 March, Bice to Ugo on 1 May, Ugo to Carlo on 1 July, with instalments issued between one transfer and the next: Ugo € 394.52, Bice € 200.55, Carlo € 604.93. Second case: Ugo becomes full owner again on 1 May and creates a usufruct for Carlo from 1 July to 1 October; with the law the item charged to the owner is Carlo's in those months: Carlo pays € 302.46 (one cent less than the € 302.47 of Carlo's 92 days, because each transfer rounds on its own), Ugo € 897.54; with «as each item says» Ugo pays € 1,200.00.

CHANGED: THERE ARE FEWER STOPS, AND THEY GIVE THE REAL REASON — A frozen plan (with shares posted to the journal, with a payment, or taken by the settlement of a transfer) is not recalculated, so it will not have the link. Where there is not a single possible title row (two identical rows of the same person, the direct charge of a person with several rows on the unit, a row changed or opened after the generation) the settlement does not decide. The stop «the shares have passed by more than one route» no longer fires on the whole unit, but only on the group of shares that the program cannot attribute, and it gives the real reason: the plan is an earlier one and does not say which row the share comes from; the row was changed after the generation with no transfer saying so; the transfer is from before 1.11.0-beta.37, when it did not note the rows touched; the reservation or the creation does not say who bought the bare ownership; the share changed hands with no transfer saying so. A group made only of prior balances with no link no longer stops. These still stop, as in .42: plans generated before 1.11.0-beta.29, on a mixed unit after a transfer; the 1.7.x shares with a prior balance absorbed by the plan; shares «never passed» to the person leaving. Where it stops, the part that passes is written with a manual balance from the Wallet.

CHANGED: A BARE OWNERSHIP MADE OF TWO PIECES THAT BECOMES FULL ONLY IN PART STOPS THE SETTLEMENT OF THE LATER TRANSFERS — It happens when a person has a bare ownership born from the sum of two bare ownerships of different origin (a reservation, a purchase, two donations on the same day), a termination makes it full again only in part, and then the person makes another transfer: the shares already issued go on the part that became full again or on the part that stayed bare, according to the piece they come from. If the sum was recorded after the plan was generated, the settlement stops for the group of shares of a person on the plan and on the unit, if one of that person's rows reaches that bare ownership, also for the share of the person leaving. What stays out is whatever the law of the transfer excludes entirely: the ordinary expenses in the reservation with the law, the extraordinary ones in the creation and in the termination. A sum made before the generation is calculated (the case of parents who donated years before).

CHANGED: A TRANSFER RECORDED BEFORE THIS VERSION WITHOUT A SETTLEMENT PAIR STOPS THE CHAIN THAT CROSSES IT — If a transfer recorded with an earlier version (from 1.11.0-beta.37, the first that notes the rows touched) took the plan into its settlement without writing any pair on that unit, it is not known whether the settlement had stopped and the part had been settled by hand: where the chain that crosses it is ambiguous, the later settlement stops and says «recorded before 1.11.0-beta.43 with no settlement pair on this unit»; with a pair written on the unit the share is followed. As a precaution, a transfer with no pair for another reason (nothing to settle, a waiver) stops it too.

CHANGED: IN A SALE, A BOX SAYS HOW TO RECORD THE AGREEMENT «THE SELLER PAYS THE INSTALMENTS» — Below the form, with no tick, the «Worth knowing» box has a sentence for the agreement «the instalments of a plan are paid by the seller»: the plan is recalculated by days and the seller's payments are recorded with «Paid by». It appears only in a sale without reserved usufruct, if the person leaving has shares in a plan that can still be recalculated (otherwise «The parties have arranged the settlement between themselves» applies).

FIXED: WHOEVER BOUGHT THE BARE OWNERSHIP AFTER A NEW USUFRUCT PAID FOR AN ENJOYMENT THAT BELONGED TO SOMEONE ELSE — With an item charged to the usufructuary, Rita has the usufruct until 1 May; Ugo, bare owner, creates a usufruct for Carlo on 1 July and sells the bare ownership to Fede on 1 September: Fede paid € 401.10 of Carlo's enjoyment, now nothing. The same with a creation «as each item says».

FIXED: AT THE END OF A USUFRUCT RESERVED IN A SALE, WHOEVER HAD BOUGHT THE BARE OWNERSHIP RECEIVED NOTHING — Ugo has the usufruct, which ended on 15 April, and Rita the bare ownership, with an item of € 600.00 charged to the owner; Rita sells to Carlo with reserved usufruct on 5 May, and Rita's usufruct ends on 18 May: the panel said that row belonged to the bare ownership that Rita kept, and nothing passed. Now, with the law, the item passes to Carlo: Carlo € 374.79, Rita € 225.21.

FIXED: TWO TRANSFERS BY THE SAME PERSON ON THE SAME DAY: WHOEVER BOUGHT THE FULL HALF ALSO PAID FOR THE BARE OWNERSHIP ALREADY SOLD — Ugo, full owner of one half and bare owner of the other, with the usufruct held by Mara, sells the bare ownership to Elsa and the full half to Nora on 30 September; with the bare ownership recorded first, Nora paid € 305.76. Now the order of recording and the days of each holder count, in both orders: Nora pays € 152.88.

FIXED: WITH A GARAGE AS APPURTENANCE, TWO SETTLEMENTS WENT TO THE WRONG PERSON — At the termination, with the bare ownership of the apartment sold to Elsa and that of the garage left with Bice, the garage pair went to Elsa, who has nothing there: now the incoming person on each unit is the bare owner of that unit. In a sale, with apartment and garage half Ugo's and half Bice's, Bice sells to Ugo the half of the apartment that Bice holds and Ugo sells everything to Elsa: Elsa paid also the days of the half of the garage that stayed with Bice (€ 80.54 on the garage), now € 40.27. The panel and the drafts count the shares of a predecessor only on the units where the predecessor handed something over to the person leaving.

FIXED: ONE CENT TOO MANY FOR THE INCOMING PERSON, IN CHAINS — Ugo sells to Elsa on 1 May, Elsa to Bruno on 1 July, Bruno to Carlo on 15 September: Carlo paid € 355.08 and Bruno € 249.85, because every holder rounded on their own; now the part of the incoming person is rounded once per plan and unit, with the largest remainders: € 355.07 and € 249.86. The same on a plan without breakdown detail: the whole settlement is € 1,006.03 (€ 1,200.00 × 306/365), not € 1,006.02.

FIXED: THE RESALE OF THE BARE OWNERSHIP, AFTER A CREATION «AS EACH ITEM SAYS», DID NOT SETTLE ON A PLAN WITHOUT BREAKDOWN DETAIL — On a plan generated before 1.11.0-beta.29, Elsa buys the bare ownership and resells it to Carlo: the resale wrote no pair, and Elsa lost Carlo's days (€ 401.10 out of € 1,200.00); now it writes one.

FIXED: THE PANEL SENTENCES SAY WHO RECEIVES THE SETTLEMENT AND WHAT HAS ALREADY PASSED — The opening of the instalments block no longer says «settlement between Ugo and Ugo» and, with an appurtenance, it names who receives the pairs, unit by unit; a share already handed over is described as «issued to Bice for a part of the unit that Ugo has already handed over»; below the bare owners the sentence says that the settlement is divided as the «What will change» panel says.

FIXED: THE HINT FOR THE END DATE OF A ROW, IN «EDIT ASSOCIATION» — It said that the instalments already issued do not change and that the settlement of the transfer takes care of them: true only if the date comes from a transfer. Now it adds that, if the date is written there, the settlement, if needed, is written with a manual balance from the Wallet.

FIXED: «RECORD TRANSFER» ON THE PHONE: THE ROW OF THE PERSON LEAVING HID THE NAME — On a narrow screen the share and the date squeezed the name until it disappeared, and the date went past the edge. Now they move below the name; the share reads «50 %», not «50.00 %».

THE GUIDES — The transfer guide has a new section, «When a usufruct ends»: without another usufruct running all the bare owners become full owners again; with another one running, only the bare owner of the usufruct that ends, recognised by the transfer from which the usufruct was born, by the sum of the shares or by the rule of law; when the data are not enough the administrator chooses; in five cases the program stops, and in three the termination is recorded by hand from «Edit association»; «Who remains liable» says that whoever becomes full owner again answers for the part of the usufruct that ends, and the holders of the rest for the rest. The first three points have their example with the figures. One new entry, «The settlement follows every share along the transfers», with the example of Ugo, Bice and Carlo; the entry «When the settlement stops» is rewritten, with the cases and the route of the manual balance from the Wallet. The entry on the drafts of the sale says how to record the agreement «the seller pays the instalments»; «Roles and usufruct» says who becomes full owner again at the end of one of the two usufructs, and that the shares of the unit that do not go back to 100 % may come from a termination recorded before this version.

NOT YET — Succession: it comes with beta.44; until then the rule of law applies, and if the deed provides for the accrual to the other usufructuary the rows are corrected by hand from «Edit association». The share-by-share calculation of a bare ownership of two pieces that became full again only in part, which today stops, comes later, probably with succession. The stops described above stay, by choice, among them a transfer recorded before 1.11.0-beta.37 that touched the share: where the datum is missing the program does not guess. The terminations already recorded with earlier versions in the forms fixed above do not correct themselves (for example two bare ownerships that became full again with a usufruct still running on one part): they are corrected by hand in the unit's card. The termination of a usufruct with no bare owner currently running is stopped only by the form, which looks at today's holders: the server would record it, and the unit would be left without an owner (from beta.44 the server refuses it too). «The person leaving pays everything» on a plan that can still be recalculated has only the sentence in the panel and in the guide (the agreement is recorded with «Paid by» and leaves no trace in the transfer), and the sale of part of one's own share is not there (the message explains how to record it by hand): they will be discussed again with a real case, after succession and before the stable release. The start of a lease on a plan that is already frozen: the tenant's part from the day of the contract stays with the owner, while the panel announces that the holder changes. The figures of the long chains with extraordinary expenses and direct charge are not yet verified case by case like the others. With «each for their share» a bare ownership row of 0.01 % may remain: a usufruct of 33.33 % ends, the person leaving is also bare owner of 66.66 %, there is another usufruct of 66.67 % and the candidates are the two bare owners at 16.67 %; the first becomes full owner again for the whole of their share (16.67 %), the second for 16.66 % and stays bare owner of 0.01 %: it is not a money error. Several transfers in a chain may still differ by a few cents from the account made in one go.

FOR DEVELOPERS — Migration 2026_10_04_120000_add_anagrafica_immobile_id_to_righe_riparto_table: righe_riparto.anagrafica_immobile_id, nullable, with a foreign key to anagrafica_immobile and nullOnDelete; idempotent, in the list of UpgradeMigrationsRerunTest. The link is written by CalcoloQuoteService (ad_personam: in the per-person calculation, with no span, only if the person has a single row on the unit; with the span, one breakdown row per title row) and GenerateRateQuotesAction::scriviDettaglio; it stays null for netting, quota_zero, the atemporal direct charge of a person with several rows on the unit and the detail rebuilt for a plan without breakdown rows. GenealogiaDellaQuota::calcola() gives, for every breakdown row, the parts or undecidable with the sentence and stops; legamiDedotti() for plans without a link. NudiDellEstinzione::per() gives nudi, da, errore, fermo and consolida to the request, the preview and the recording; RegistraSubentroAction::applicaRighe() splits the row of a bare owner who becomes full owner again only in part. AnteprimaPassaggio also returns nudi and cancello.avvisi. In the transfer log: version 3 (GenealogiaDellaQuota below 3 applies the previous rule) and, at the termination, nudi, which FrasiObbligati::daSubentro() reads for the «Who remains liable» of the history. JS: nudiInteri.ts, percentuale.ts, PassaggioNew.vue. New tests: CateneDelConguaglioTest, EstinzioneConPiuUsufruttiTest, LegameRigheRipartoTest.
